meta.description: PPWR is one regulation. The work behind it quickly multiplies. LIVO PPWR keeps packaging data, obligations, evidence and supplier input together and up to date.

hero.apply: PPWR has applied across the EU since 12 August 2026, with requirements phasing in over time.
hero.titleBefore: PPWR is one regulation. The work behind it quickly
hero.lead: The challenge is not collecting packaging data once. It is keeping data, obligations and evidence connected and up to date as products, packaging and markets change.
hero.walkthroughBody:
Hello Livo,

I would like a 20-minute walkthrough of LIVO PPWR.

Name:
Company:
A few dates that work for me:

grows.title: Every product, packaging level and market adds another layer to manage.
grows.lead: A spreadsheet can hold PPWR data. It does not help you manage obligations, evidence, gaps and changes across all your products.

factors.title: Products
factors.body: The products you put on the market and need to track.

factors.title: Packaging levels
factors.body: Primary, secondary and transport packaging, plus their layers.

factors.title: EU markets
factors.body: EU-wide PPWR rules sit alongside Member State registration and reporting.

factors.title: Obligations and proof
factors.body: Requirements, deadlines, reports and evidence that can expire.

grows.resultTitle: One change can affect several places at once.
grows.resultBody: A new supplier, a changed material, an expired report or a new requirement means the picture needs to be checked again.

costs.eyebrow: What this starts to cost you
costs.title: When PPWR stays manual, the bill keeps growing.

items.title: It takes too much time.
items.body: Checking, chasing, updating and rebuilding answers quickly turns PPWR into ongoing manual work.

items.title: Customer requests become a commercial risk.
items.body: If packaging data and proof are not ready when customers ask, you risk delays, rework and lost business.

items.title: You lose control as things change.
items.body: With data spread across files and systems, it is hard to see what is complete, outdated or still missing.

items.title: The work depends on a few people.
items.body: When context lives in spreadsheets, folders and inboxes, one absence can slow down the whole process.

costs.transition: PPWR is ongoing work. When it stays manual, time, rework and customer pressure keep adding up.

changes.title: Built to make ongoing PPWR work easier to manage.
changes.benefit: Save time. Share the work. Keep everything together. Know where you stand.
changes.lead: From the first import onwards, the workflow helps you fill gaps, manage changes and maintain a complete product file.

features.title: Your Excel. No rigid template.
features.body: Start with the files you already have instead of reshaping everything first. Livo reads the structure, asks when it is unsure and remembers the format. The preview shows what will change before anything is saved, and re-imports update instead of duplicating. Export works the same way, so your data is never locked in.

features.title: Know where you stand.
features.body: See what is complete, missing, expired or still open, per product and per market, with obligations mapped out to 2040. Evidence carries an expiry date; when it expires, it stops counting on its own. Less checking by hand, and fewer surprises when a customer asks.

features.title: Let suppliers do part of the work.
features.body: Send a prefilled request from your own mailbox: a secure link to the supplier portal, or a prefilled Excel per supplier. Suppliers see what you already know and add only what is missing. Their answers come back as proposed updates for your review. Nothing overwrites what you had.

features.title: Keep the file complete and up to date.
features.body: Keep packaging data, evidence and status together, so changes are easier to manage. Generate the declaration of conformity and the technical documentation from the same maintained source, with an append-only attestation trail behind it. Entering, confirming and signing are separate rights, held by the people you designate.

cycle.title: Let suppliers fill the gaps.
cycle.lead: You send the request; LIVO prepares it. Suppliers add only what is missing and every answer comes back as a proposal for your review.

steps.title: Prefilled request
steps.body: LIVO prepares a request per supplier with everything you already know filled in.

steps.title: You send it
steps.body: A secure link or a prefilled Excel, sent from your own mailbox. LIVO does not e-mail your suppliers for you.

steps.title: Supplier fills the gaps
steps.body: Only what is missing, with plain-language explanations of each field.

steps.title: Proposed updates
steps.body: Answers land as proposals. You review and confirm; nothing overwrites what you had.

forWhom.title: Four questions to see whether this is your work.
forWhom.lead: PPWR assigns obligations by role, per product and per market. These questions help you see where you stand.

cards.title: Own-brand manufacturers
cards.body: Your name on the box makes you the manufacturer. Is the file per product ready to stand behind, with the evidence to back it?

cards.title: Importers
cards.body: Packaging you bring into the EU is yours to answer for. Do you have the supplier data and proof for every product you import?

cards.title: Wholesalers and distributors
cards.body: Only your own brands and imports count; what you resell does not. Do you know which of your products that is, per market?

cards.title: Logistics and fulfilment
cards.body: The box you fill and the pallet you wrap are your packaging. Do you know which role PPWR gives you, per flow, and what your customers will ask for?

closing.title: See LIVO PPWR in a 20-minute walkthrough.
closing.lead: See how it can reduce manual work, supplier chasing and repeated rework. Or start free with your own packaging data.

plans.customTitle: More than 10,000 SKUs? Let's talk it through.
plans.customBody: At that size the honest answer depends on your catalogue, so we'd rather look at it together than print a number.

get.title: From a messy supplier file to a declaration you dare to sign.
get.body: That chain is the product. Every step below works today, in every paid plan.

items.title: Import any Excel, no rigid template
items.body: Upload your own data exports or whatever a supplier sends. Livo reads the structure (bottle, box, carton, pallet), shows you what it found and asks when it isn't sure. You confirm instead of retype, and the same file shape is recognised next time. No fixed format to fight with first.

items.title: Ask suppliers via portal and tasks, not email threads
items.body: Request exactly what's missing: your supplier gets a link with plain-language questions and tasks, legally reviewed guidance per field, and a place to drop their PDFs. No mailbox full of half-filled spreadsheets, and nothing a supplier sends ever overwrites what you already had.

items.title: Always know where you stand
items.body: One live overview of your obligations, deadlines and readiness: per product, per role, per market, through 2040. And it stays honest: expired evidence automatically stops counting, so the status you see is the status that's true today.

items.title: The complete compliance file, per product
items.body: Declaration of conformity, technical file, test documents and an append-only attestation trail, generated from your own data and kept together per product. Livo waits until the required evidence is there, and signing is a separate right. When someone asks how you know, you show them.

replaces.title: Compare the whole bill, not the licence line.
replaces.body: Traditional compliance software is rarely just a licence. The number that matters is what leaves your account in a year, and how well you could predict it in advance.
replaces.footnote: Figures for traditional suppliers are the ranges we see quoted in this market; your mileage will vary. The point isn't that we're cheap. It's that you can work out your total cost before you sign, and it stays that way.

everyPlan.title: We limit one thing: how many SKUs you're responsible for.
everyPlan.body: Every paid plan is the same product. No per-user pricing, no per-market pricing, no feature tiers.
items: Unlimited users, roles and packaging levels
Excel import & export with live validation
Obligation timeline per role × market, to 2040
everyPlan.freeNote: Free is the one plan with limits: it stops at 25 SKUs and leaves out signed declaration downloads and integrations. Everything else is identical.
everyPlan.onboarding: Getting started: there's no implementation fee and no implementation project. We set up your environment with you (markets, users and roles), usually within a day. From there it's yours to run. Self-service onboarding is being built; until it ships we'd rather do that step with you than pretend it's already a button.

integrations.title: Integrations aren't here yet. When they ship, they're in your plan.
integrations.body: Only Excel import and export exist today, and they carry the whole workflow. The connectors below are still to be built. We list them so you know what's coming and, more importantly, that they'll simply be part of your plan when they arrive.

items.title: Excel import & export
items.body: Upload the supplier template, review what we recognised, confirm. Re-import updates instead of duplicating.

items.title: Native ERP connectors
items.body: Exact Online first. Dynamics 365 BC, SAP Business One and Odoo follow where customers ask for them.

items.title: REST API + integration builder
items.body: Connect your PIM or any other system yourself: map the fields in the app, no code required.

items.title: GS1 / GDSN publishing
items.body: Publish packaging and PPWR attributes straight to the data pool, with code-list mappings as a ready-made template.

integrations.custom: A system of your own? A legacy or niche integration is tailored work: a one-time development fee quoted up front, plus a monthly care fee from €199.

items.q: What exactly counts as a SKU?
items.a: One sellable product you put on the EU market yourself: under your own brand (private label included) or as the importer. Packaging levels, components and materials are never counted, however many you have. Everything you resell as a distributor is free and unlimited, and archived products don't count either.

items.q: What if I go slightly over my plan?
items.a: Nothing happens. We look at a rolling three-month average, so a seasonal peak passes by unnoticed. If your portfolio is structurally larger, we'll get in touch and move you up. You'll never find out through a blocked screen or a surprise invoice.

items.q: My suppliers are slow. Does that block me?
items.a: It's the most common bottleneck, so the product is built around it: send a portal link or export exactly what's missing, and a partly filled return leaves what you already had intact. You keep working on everything else, and you can see per product who you're waiting on.

items.q: Are there setup or implementation fees?
items.a: No. Connectors, the API and GS1 publishing will be included in paid plans when they ship. The one exception is a fully custom integration with a legacy system: tailored work, quoted up front.
Any time, in one click from Billing. Your data stays yours and stays exportable; anything above a lower limit becomes read-only, never lost.

items.q: Why is this simpler than everyone else?
items.a: Because the price follows the regulation. PPWR puts the obligations on whoever places a product on the market. We count exactly those products and charge for them, nothing else. That takes out the scoping call, the implementation project and the quote you can't compare.

closing.title: Ready to lighten the workflow?
closing.body: Start free with your own packaging data. The first PPWR obligations have applied since 12 August 2026.
